caption:
Figure 2. Overview of Select-TTT. (1) The frozen LM head maps chunk hidden
states to logit space, where query-token scores are aggregated by top- k k mean pooling to assess chunk relevance. (2) Relevance scores are converted
into learning-rate multipliers. (3) In-Place TTT computes the NTP-aligned
fast-weight updates. (4) The multipliers rescale these updates to selectively
write query-relevant information into fast-weight memory.
